title: 08. GraphRAG: Microsoft GraphRAG Deep Dive
summary: Microsoft GraphRAG (released 2024) is an end-to-end framework that constructs a hierarchical community graph from source documents, then uses that graph for both local (entity-centric) and global (theme-level) question answering.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Microsoft GraphRAG (released 2024) is an end-to-end framework that constructs a **hierarchical community graph** from source documents, then uses that graph for both **local** (entity-centric) and **global** (theme-level) question answering. The pipeline has two phases: **Indexing** — chunk documents into TextUnits, extract entity/relationship triples via LLM, resolve entities, assign to communities via Leiden algorithm, generate community summaries, embed everything — and **Querying** — local search expands from entity matches; global search uses map-reduce over community reports. Key differentiator: **global search** can answer thematic questions ("What are the main themes?") that vector RAG cannot, because community summaries capture document-wide patterns. Critical operational concerns: cost ($0.10–$1.00 per document in LLM tokens), storage backend choices (filesystem, Azure Blob, CosmosDB), and incremental update capability for live corpora.

diagrams.title: Microsoft GraphRAG global search (map-reduce)
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TB
  Q["global question: main risks across all reports?"] --> MAP["map: ask each community summary"]
  MAP --> A1["partial answer + score — community 1"]
  MAP --> A2["partial answer + score — community 2"]
  MAP --> A3["partial answer + score — community N"]
  A1 --> RED["reduce: keep top-scored partials"]
  A2 --> RED
  A3 --> RED
  RED --> OUT(["final synthesized answer"])
diagrams.explain: Global search cannot fit the whole corpus into one prompt, so it **maps** the question over pre-computed community summaries, scores each partial answer, and **reduces** the best ones into a final answer. Powerful for sense-making questions, but indexing is expensive — every chunk goes through an LLM.

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
         MICROSOFT GRAPHRAG FULL PIPELINE

  INDEXING PHASE
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                                                              │
  │  Source Documents                                            │
  │  (txt, pdf, docx)                                            │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼                                                     │
  │  [CHUNK] TextUnits (1200 tokens, 100 overlap)               │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼ (parallel LLM calls, 25 concurrent)                │
  │  [EXTRACT] Entity + Relationship triples per chunk           │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼                                                     │
  │  [DEDUPLICATE] Entity resolution + description merge         │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼                                                     │
  │  [CLUSTER] Leiden community detection (multi-level)          │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼ (parallel LLM calls)                               │
  │  [SUMMARISE] Community reports (LLM-generated)               │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼                                                     │
  │  [EMBED] Entity + TextUnit + Relation embeddings             │
  │        │                                                     │
  │        ▼                                                     │
  │  [STORE] Parquet files + Vector store (LanceDB/Azure)        │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  QUERY PHASE
  ┌────────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
  │   LOCAL SEARCH     │     │         GLOBAL SEARCH            │
  │                    │     │                                  │
  │  Entity questions  │     │  Thematic questions              │
  │  "Who is X?"       │     │  "What are main themes?"         │
  │                    │     │                                  │
  │  Query → Vector    │     │  MAP: score each community       │
  │  → BFS expansion   │     │  (parallel, async)               │
  │  → TextUnit lookup │     │                                  │
  │  → LLM answer      │     │  REDUCE: synthesize from top-20  │
  │                    │     │  relevant communities → answer   │
  └────────────────────┘     └──────────────────────────────────┘

  COST OPTIMISATION LEVERS
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Setting          Default     Optimised    Savings      │
  ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │  extraction model gpt-4o      gpt-4o-mini  ~20x        │
  │  max_gleanings    1           0            -50% calls  │
  │  embedding model  ada-002     3-small      ~6x         │
  │  chunk_size       300 tokens  1200 tokens  -75% chunks │
  │  community model  gpt-4o      gpt-4o-mini  ~20x        │
  │  caching          off         on           -90% reruns │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
